genant.r1_d: Your couple exists, but you keep it to yourselves. In public, you're two people who happen to know each other. In private, that's a different story. You like having a space that's all yours, inaccessible to the outside gaze, and that's a perfectly valid way to operate. Some couples build themselves away from the world, and it holds up just fine. The only thing to watch out for: that this discretion doesn't turn into distance. That it's an active, shared choice, not a habit that crept in without either of you noticing.

genant.r2_d: You love each other, it shows, and you don't traumatise anyone. You've found a balance that many are looking for. Close enough for it to be felt, discreet enough for the people around you not to feel assaulted. You allow yourselves little moments without turning it into a public display, and that's probably why people enjoy being around you two. It's not the most spectacular score, but it's often the most pleasant to live with, for you and for everyone around.

genant.r3_d: You live your life, people adapt. You don't overthink what others think, and that's generally good news. You have your own things, your codes, your moments, and you don't really hide them. The people around you know you're together, in every sense of the word. Just be careful to keep an eye on situations where your partner doesn't quite share your level of uninhibitedness that day. The freedom to be embarrassing works better when both of you are all in.
genant.r3_a: Are you the type to share everything? Check out the "Who knows their partner best" quiz.
genant.r4_d: Your couple is a life experience for everyone around. You live your relationship to the fullest, and to the fullest means in public too. The people around you probably have opinions about your couple, stories to tell, and maybe a few images that are hard to erase. You call it loving without restraint. Hard to say you're wrong. The only real question: is your partner at exactly the same level as you? Because "unfiltered together" is one thing, "unfiltered alone while the other one manages the fallout" is another.

genant.r5_d: People remember the parties where you were there. You're a monument couple. An experience. The people who spend time with you either have a genuine affection for you two, or a stockpile of stories for dinner parties. Either way, you leave nobody indifferent. There's a kind of freedom in there that's pretty rare. Embarrassment, you've digested it so thoroughly that it doesn't really exist anymore. It's almost a higher level of peace of mind, just reached through an unusual path. One question for the road: does your circle tell you this with a smile or with a slight grimace? The answer to that is your only real indicator.
